content.user_title: Generate Music with ElevenLabs on RunComfy
content.value_statement: Creating production-ready music prompts and CLI calls can be slow and error-prone. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through ElevenLabs Music generation on RunComfy with clear parameters and workflow advice.
actual_capabilities: Creates style briefs and structured lyric prompts for ElevenLabs Music.
Sets duration with music_length_ms within the documented 5 second to 5 minute range.
Uses force_instrumental for instrumental beds, loops, jingles, and intros.
Invokes the RunComfy model endpoint through the local runcomfy CLI.
Explains output formats, generated audio downloads, pricing, and common exit codes.
limitations: Requires a working RunComfy CLI installation and authentication.
Does not generate sound effects, speech, voice cloning, or specific singer identities.
Does not verify lyric rights or commercial licensing claims for user-provided text.
Longer tracks cost more and may need external editing for pieces over five minutes.

use_cases.title: Produce a Brand Jingle
use_cases.description: Create a short instrumental or vocal music idea with clear duration, mood, and ending guidance.

use_cases.title: Draft Podcast Music
use_cases.description: Generate intro, outro, or background beds with consistent tone and loop-friendly structure.

use_cases.title: Build Game Loops
use_cases.description: Prepare instrumental prompts for level themes, menus, or ambient gameplay loops.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Short Instrumental
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple music asset
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 15 second instrumental jingle for [brand or project]. Use [mood], [genre], [main instruments], and no vocals. Keep it clean for an intro.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Vocal Song Draft
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with song sections and lyrics
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a RunComfy prompt for a 45 second [genre] song about [theme]. Include [Intro], [Verse], [Chorus], and [Outro] sections with simple lyrics.

prompt_templates.title: Refine a Structured Track
prompt_templates.prompt: Revise this music prompt for ElevenLabs Music. Improve meter, section labels, instruments, tempo, and duration while keeping the same message: [draft prompt].

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Multilingual Release
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for several localized versions
prompt_templates.prompt: Create prompts for three language versions of the same song. Keep tempo, genre, structure, and instrumentation consistent, and change only the lyrics and language notes.

output_examples.input: A 20 second upbeat product launch jingle with no vocals.
output_examples.output: A concise generation plan with upbeat pop instrumentation, instrumental mode, a clean ending, and a 20 second duration.

output_examples.input: A one minute indie-pop song with verse and chorus.
output: A style brief with tempo, instruments, and vocal tone.
Section-labeled lyrics for intro, verse, chorus, bridge, and outro.
A duration recommendation for a short draft before a full render.

output_examples.input: A calm loop for a study game menu.
output_examples.output: An instrumental prompt focused on mellow rhythm, consistent groove, loop-friendly structure, and no vocals.

best_practices: Draft at 30 to 45 seconds before rendering a full track.
Use clear section labels and consistent lyric meter for vocal songs.
Keep prompts to one coherent genre, mood, tempo, and instrument set.
anti_patterns: Requesting copyrighted lyrics or artist impersonation without rights.
Combining conflicting styles, tempos, or vocal directions in one prompt.
Rendering five minute versions before testing short drafts.

faq.question: Does this skill create audio directly?
faq.answer: It guides the AI to use the local runcomfy CLI, which submits the request and downloads the generated audio.

faq.question: Do I need a RunComfy account?
faq.answer: Yes. The CLI must be installed and authenticated before generation can run.

faq.question: Can it make instrumental music?
faq.answer: Yes. Use instrumental mode and describe no vocals in the music prompt.

faq.question: What is the maximum track length?
faq.answer: The documented range is 5 seconds to 5 minutes per generation call.

faq.question: Can it clone a specific singer?
faq.answer: No. This endpoint does not request specific voice identities or cloning.

faq.question: Can I use generated music commercially?
faq.answer: The skill describes the output as commercial-friendly, but users must verify current provider terms and rights for supplied lyrics.
